Only one MCU should be present/populated, or an alternate footprint should be explicitly unpopulated/DNP. Two MCUs sharing all I/O, VCC, GND, and reset are not a valid single-controller architecture.

J2 I2C_PWR 2-pin (maybe power for I2C? J2 pin1 net to J3 pin1; pin2 +5V). J3 I2C 5-pin (maybe GND, VCC? Actually J3 pin5 GND, pin4 NET0004 (reset), pin3 NET0006 SCK, pin2 NET0008 MOSI, pin1 Net-(J2-Pin_1). J4 POT 3-pin (pin1 +5V, pin2 NET0003 PB3, pin3 GND). So Q3 driven from NET0002 (MISO/PB1) to switch PMOS low-side? R6 pull-up gate to source keeps PMOS off. Q3 pulls gate low to turn PMOS on. So VCC_OUT controlled by NET0002.

D2 zener 5V1: anode GND, cathode NET0011. R1 1K between NET0011 and NET0005 (J1 pin3). R8 10K pull-up from VCC to NET0011. NET0011 also PB4 of both ATtinys. So PB4 connected to fan tach? Fan pin3 maybe tach output open collector. R8 pull-up to VCC, R1 series to fan pin3, D2 zener clamp to 5.1V? If VCC maybe >5? Let's see U3 LM1117-5.0 input VCC output +5V. If pull-up R8 to VCC, zener clamps NET0011, series R1 to fan tach. For open-collector tach, fan pulls pin3 low, current flows from VCC through R8 to NET0011 through R1 to fan low? But zener at NET0011 to GND would conduct if >5.1; when fan low, NET0011 near 0? Need current path: R8 from VCC to NET0011, R1 from NET0011 to J1.3. If J1.3 is tach output open drain to GND, then current VCC->R8->NET0011->R1->J1.3->GND. NET0011 voltage = I*R1 maybe. Zener from NET0011 to GND reverse biased? Cathode NET0011, anode GND. - U1 and U4 both ATtiny connected in parallel on many pins: PB0 MOSI, PB1 MISO/NET0002, PB2 SCK, PB3 pot, PB4 tach, PB5 reset. Two MCUs sharing ISP and fan? Could be intended? Maybe one is I2C? But no I2C pins? ATtiny45/13V no hardware I2C? They have USI? ATtiny13/45 have USI? ATtiny13 has USI? ATtiny45 has USI? They can do software I2C. But all pins tied together? U1 and U4 connected pin-to-pin for PB0-PB4, reset. That means two MCUs driving same lines, likely anomaly? But maybe one is a rescue? Wait U1 ATtiny45-20P DIP, U4 ATtiny13V-10S SOIC. Both VCC/GND. U1 pin1 PB5 to NET0004; U4 pin1 PB5 to NET0004.
